findings.claim_text: The EU AI Act summary, section 2.5, lists GLM-5.3, GLM-5.2-fp8, Kimi-K2.6 and Qwen3.8-27B as generator models but attaches no purpose to any of them [^3].
Meanwhile, the launch post says Aleph Alpha "generated a total of 174B tokens worth of synthetic data" for SFT inside a 268B-token mix [^2].
Its 967-prompt, 56-topic benchmark, judged by GPT-OSS-120B, found "six Chinese models answered only 17 to 41 percent of prompts in a balanced way" [^5].
